class.name: ImageTexture

method.name: create_from_image
method.description: Creates a new [ImageTexture] and initializes it by allocating and setting the data from an [Image].

method.name: set_image
method.description: Replaces the texture's data with a new [Image]. This will re-allocate new memory for the texture. If you want to update the image, but don't need to change its parameters (format, size), use [method update] instead for better performance.

method.name: set_size_override
method.description: Resizes the texture to the specified dimensions.

method.name: update
method.description: Replaces the texture's data with a new [Image]. [b]Note:[/b] The texture has to be created using [method create_from_image] or initialized first with the [method set_image] method before it can be updated. The new image dimensions, format, and mipmaps configuration should match the existing texture's image configuration. Use this method over [method set_image] if you need to update the texture frequently, which is faster than allocating additional memory for a new texture each time.
